audit.whatIsWrong: Full layer called this HARD 8/10 with Galio owning all seven rows, while content win[] and packet.levelChart both give all seven rows to Fizz at a 51.24% win rate over 3749 games.
audit.why: A 51.24% matchup is not an 8/10 hard lane, and the full layer disagreed with the content layer on every single row.
audit.corrected: diff EVEN, diffRating 5/10, carryRating 7/10, tone amber, all seven phases[].side moved to Fizz as one atomic group.

audit.why: Level 6 is genuinely flat here: Hero's Entrance is a 180-second team engage with no solo punish, so your shark spike still carries the row.

audit.whatIsWrong: Justice Punch was tracked with no cooldown, Shield of Durand's charge-up was never mentioned, and the mid-game text gave Nimble Fighter tenacity.
audit.why: Justice Punch (E) is 11/10/9/8/7 and is Galio's only gap-closer knockup; Shield of Durand (W) is 18/17/16/15/14 and must be charged before the taunt releases, which is the visible tell; Hero's Entrance is 180/160/140. Fizz's passive is unit-walking plus flat damage reduction, not tenacity.
audit.corrected: Cooldowns field, dosFull[1].d, dontsFull[2].d and mid all rewritten on those numbers.

audit.why: Both ultimates displace (Chum the Waters knockup vs Hero's Entrance knockup), so the first one landed owns the trade — already reflected in the roam/dive line.
